text:
Type: knitted hanging baskets, set of two
Use: hanging storage for small toys, books or bits on a bed, a wall or a hook; children's room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: thick crochet-knit yarn, knitted loop handles
Colors: bright cobalt blue, purple handles
Shape: two soft round pouches in different sizes with slightly flared openings, a single loop handle each for hanging, slouchy and light
Feel: playful, bright, soft, cozy
Goes with: white furniture, bold blues and pinks, light wood; playful children's rooms or colorful modern spaces

product.name: STICKAT
product.description: Space-saving baskets that help to keep your childrens belongings organised.
